name: Princess of Worlds End
source:
Play as Princess, a high-maintenance 21-year-old girl who earned the nickname through her bratty behavior. After running away from home at 16, she worked dead-end job after dead-end job in order to survive and manage her addiction to a pain pill called Numb-X. 

The story begins with her waking up in a forest late at night during a rainstorm after getting knocked unconscious and robbed of all her belongings. Through a strange series of events, she unlocks a new power that will change her life forever. You will help guide Princess to get her life together, manage her relationships and, most importantly, prevent the end of the world.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3730050/Princess_of_Worlds_End/]Steam[/url]]
